name: SVN Bay Parck
overview: SVN Bay Parck Beach Resort is a forty-five-acre coastal development on the Bay of Bengal at Jeerupalem, Ranastalam, Srikakulam district, Andhra Pradesh, by SVN ShivaJyothi Group.
It is the group's largest destination to date, begun in 2022.
